title: Sharp Sample Complexity of KL-Regularized Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.13480v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: KL-regularized reinforcement learning, the objective behind maximum-entropy RL and RL from human feedback, is variational inference in the graphical model of "control as inference": the regularized optimal policy is a posterior over trajectories, and the suboptimality of a policy is $\beta$ times a KL divergence between path measures. However, it is not known how many samples it takes to learn this posterior, even with a generative model. Earlier $1/\epsilon$ guarantees scale with $H^5$ in the effective horizon $H$, and no lower bound for MDPs depends on the temperature $\beta$. In this work, we show that for a discounted MDP with $K$ state-action pairs, the plug-in estimator finds a policy that is $\epsilon$-optimal from every initial state with $\widetilde{O}(KH^3/(\epsilon\max\{\epsilon,\beta\}) + KH)$ samples, and that no algorithm, even one that chooses where to sample, can do with fewer when $\epsilon \lesssim \min\{H, H^2/\beta\

translated_title: KL正则化强化学习的精确样本复杂度
translated_abstract: KL正则化强化学习——即最大熵强化学习和基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）背后的目标——本质上是“控制即推断”图模型中的变分推断：正则化最优策略是轨迹上的后验分布，而策略的次优性等于β乘以路径测度之间的KL散度。然而，即使拥有生成模型，学习这一后验分布需要多少样本仍是未知的。此前的1/ε保证在有效视界H上按H⁵的规模增长，且针对MDP的下界均不依赖于温度β。在这项工作中，我们证明了对于具有K个状态-动作对的折扣MDP，插件估计器仅需Õ(KH³/(ε·max{ε, β}) + KH)个样本，就能找到一个从每个初始状态出发均为ε-最优的策略；并且当ε ≲ min{H, H²/β}时，即使是可以自主选择采样位置的算法，也无法用更少的样本达到这一目标。
tldr: 本文证明了在KL正则化强化学习中，插件估计器仅需Õ(KH³/(ε·max{ε,β})+KH)个样本即可找到ε-最优策略，并给出了匹配的下界，将先前样本复杂度对有效视界的依赖从H⁵改进为H³，且首次建立了依赖温度β的下界。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that in KL-regularized RL, the plug-in estimator finds an ε-optimal policy with Õ(KH³/(ε·max{ε,β})+KH) samples, establishes a matching lower bound that depends on the temperature β, and improves the prior H⁵ horizon dependence to H³.
